lean.name: Formalism.DworkPowerSeriesWeights.LemmaRA
lean.note: The multivariable estimate bounds the valuation of derivatives of an integral series after the inverse logarithmic substitution and multiplication by a signed exponential. The contribution from order $\kappa_i$ in variable $i$ is $\kappa_i(\gamma_\ell-\varsigma_i)$, with the weights $\varsigma_i$ constrained by the coefficients of the exponential’s argument.
